instruction: Write a Python class representing a bank account with deposit, withdraw and balance methods, rejecting negative amounts and overdrafts.
Write a Python dataclass for a Product with validation in __post_init__ (name non-empty, price non-negative) and a total_price method applying a discount percentage.
Write a Python class Library that manages a collection of Book objects (add, remove, find_by_author, count) with readable __repr__ output.
Write a Python class implementing a Stack (push, pop, peek, is_empty, size) backed by a list, raising IndexError on empty pop.
Write a Python class implementing a thread-safe FIFO queue with put, get and task_done semantics using collections.deque and threading.Condition.
Write an abstract base class Shape with abstract area and perimeter methods, plus concrete Circle and Rectangle subclasses, rejecting instantiation of Shape itself.
Write a Python class that implements the singleton pattern via __new__ so that repeated constructions return the same instance with shared state.
Write a Python class Vector2D that supports addition, scalar multiplication, equality comparison and a useful __repr__ via operator overloading.
Write a Python class Temperature that stores Celsius as the canonical value but exposes celsius and fahrenheit properties with getters and setters, converting automatically.
Write an immutable Point class that raises AttributeError on any attribute assignment after initialization, and supports equality and hashing.
Write a Python class Tally that behaves like a dict but returns 0 for missing keys and counts occurrences via a count method.
Write a Python class Counter with __getitem__, __setitem__, __contains__ and increment/decrement methods that supports default initialization to zero.
Write a Python class ShoppingCart that stores items in a dict (name to quantity), supports add, remove, total cost with a price table, and an itemized __str__ receipt.
Write a Python class LinkedList with singly linked nodes supporting append, delete, reverse in place, and conversion to a list.
Write a Python class hierarchy for custom exceptions: AppError base, then ValidationError and NotFoundError, each carrying a user-friendly message and machine-readable code.
Write a Python descriptor class ValidatedField that enforces a minimum and maximum numeric range on attributes it manages.
Write a Python class that uses a classmethod alternative constructor and static helper methods to parse 'WxH' dimensions and validate them.
Write a Python class Deck that models a shuffled deck of playing cards with deal(n), remaining count, and __iter__ support yielding cards one at a time.
Write a Python class Money that stores integer cents, supports addition, subtraction, allocation across ratios without losing pennies, and formats as currency.
Write a Python class GameScore that tracks high scores with add_player, top(n), rank_of(player) and an __contains__ check, keeping the list sorted descending.
